label: QKI::RAF1

sections.text: QKI encodes an RNA-binding protein that regulates RNA processing and myelination.
RAF1 encodes CRAF, a RAF-family serine/threonine kinase in the MAPK pathway.

The fusion removes RAF1 amino-terminal inhibition while retaining its kinase domain and partner self-association regions. Both fusions have demonstrated transforming activity and activation of MAPK/PI3K signaling in experimental glioma systems.
Drug-response studies support investigation of RAF-dimer and downstream pathway inhibition. The BRAF-fusion tovorafenib indication does not automatically include RAF1 fusions.
